sahneler.metin: Gemini 6A's engines ignited, then suddenly shut down on the pad.
The mission clock started, signalling lift-off, but the rocket hadn't moved.
Rules said the crew should eject.
Wally Schirra felt no movement and decided not to.
An electrical plug had dropped out early.
But thrust had already been decaying.
A plastic dust cover had been left inside the engine.
It had blocked the flow of oxidizer.

aciklama:
